sources.title: Rich feature hierarchies (R-CNN) (Girshick et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: R-CNN applies high-capacity CNNs to bottom-up region proposals and improves VOC 2012 mAP by >30% relative (53.3%) via two insights: CNN-on-proposals for localization, and supervised pre-training (classification) followed by domain-specific fine-tuning when detection labels are scarce.
Bottleneck addressed: VOC detection plateau under complex ensembles of handcrafted features; mechanism fuses classical CV (region proposals) with deep learning rather than opposing them.
Historical role (VM-O02): region-proposal detection origin; pre-training/fine-tuning paradigm later inherited across vision.
claims.context: Edition-level analytical synthesis by the Work operator (lineage/selection/boundary/contract judgment, not a literal statement of the cited source); structural home for edition rationale.

limitations.text: Multi-stage pipeline speed addressed only as future work; R-CNN itself is slow by later standards.
